# DIR UVP Sprint

> A one-day working session (Day In Room) that produces one tested unique value proposition a B2B leadership team agrees on. Fixed price: $35,000. The diagnostic report from the UVP Clarity Check is provided before any contact is requested; no sales call is required.

DIR UVP Sprint (uvpsprint.com) is operated by Mediathink. It is a single positioning-and-messaging engagement — not a SaaS product, API, or self-serve purchase. The site also hosts a free "UVP Clarity Check" tool that returns an evidence-cited diagnostic of a company's own public materials; the tool is diagnostic only and does not prescribe messaging.

## Core pages
- [Homepage](https://uvpsprint.com/): the offer, fixed price, process, fit criteria, FAQ, and the UVP Clarity Check tool.
- [The structure of a finished UVP](https://uvpsprint.com/structure): the architecture of the deliverable.

## Method evidence (working documents from completed engagements, client identities removed)
- [Participant Prep Sheet](https://uvpsprint.com/evidence-prep-sheet): what each participant must bring before the session.
- [Executive Overview](https://uvpsprint.com/evidence-executive-overview): the frame that does not change with the client, shown across two engagements.
- [Day In The Room Agenda](https://uvpsprint.com/evidence-agenda): the session hour by hour — segments, decision rules, required roles.
- [Decision Checklist](https://uvpsprint.com/evidence-decision-checklist): the pre-session instrument; eleven decisions, each with a required conclusion.
- [The Structure of a Finished UVP](https://uvpsprint.com/evidence-structure-template): the full architecture of the deliverable, cells empty.
